reviews.text: Super cute, comes with more than enough to last a long time! They’re so small so please use tweezers because they’re so hard to put on manually. I wish they came in clusters of two or three lashes I feel like they’d be easier to place on the corners of the eyes but for the center and sides they’re perfect for it!
reviews.zh: 超級可愛，份量多到可以用好耐！佢哋好細，所以請用鑷子，因為用手好難裝。我希望佢哋可以兩三支一組，我覺得咁就更容易放喺眼角位置，不過放喺中間同兩側就啱晒！

reviews.text: This is my first time buying this kind of fake eyelashes. CORINGCO is doing a great job making these lashes. I struggle few times, but it wasn’t too hard to apply it. The only thing to keep mind is when picking the lash with tweezers. Hold it from the middle otherwise the side lash will come to the middle. Other than that, it makes your eye like K-idol.
reviews.zh: 呢個係我第一次買呢類假睫毛。CORINGCO 整呢款睫毛做得好好。我試咗幾次都有啲吃力，不過都唔算太難裝。要留意嘅係用鑷子夾嗰時，要由中間夾，否則側邊嗰條睫毛會跑到中間。除此之外，會令你對眼似 K-idol 咁。

reviews.text: I tried these lashes today and I am suprised with how well they work! I just used 4 pieces of 9mm on the outer corner of my eyes and I love the effect. It’s subtle and elegant, plus I took a nap and they stayed on pretty well. I will never go back to lashes with bands after trying this.
reviews.zh: 我今日試咗呢款睫毛，好驚喜佢效果咁好！我只係喺眼尾用咗四片 9mm，我好鍾意個效果。好自然優雅，而且我瞓咗一陣覺，佢都仲好好咁貼住。試過呢款之後，我以後都唔會返去用有膠帶嘅假睫毛。

reviews.text: I was super excited to get those as I thought it would look very natural and not to heavy like the ones were you have the full eyelash. It was my first time trying them on and as I started with right eye I was surprised how easy it was to glue them on on my first try but girl... the left eye was a different story lol. I have to learn how to apply them but overall amazing product.
reviews.zh: 我好期待收到呢款，因為我以為佢睇落會好自然，唔似嗰啲全條睫毛咁厚重。呢次係我第一次試，我由右眼開始，好驚訝自己第一次就可以咁容易黏上去，但係……左眼就係另一回事 lol。我仲要學吓點樣裝，不過整體嚟講係好正嘅產品。

reviews.text: These single lashes look natural and effortless. It takes a bit of a practice to learn how to use them, but when you figure it out you can create a very nice look with them. My eye makeup looks much better when I use these and it also covers imperfections on my eyeliner.
reviews.zh: 呢款單根睫毛睇落好自然，毫不費力。要練吓先學識點用，但係一旦掌握咗，就可以整出好靚嘅效果。我用呢款嘅時候，眼妝睇落好靚好多，而且仲可以遮蓋眼線上嘅瑕疵。

reviews.text: I got 10mm & 11mm. it's a bit tricky to get them on at first but honestly after practicing for a bit i finally got the hang of it. they are time consuming though so i wouldn't recommend them if you need lashes that are easy & fast to put on
reviews.zh: 我買咗 10mm 同 11mm。起初有少少難裝，不過老實講，練習一陣之後，我終於掌握到技巧。不過佢哋好花時間，所以如果你需要一款容易又快手裝嘅睫毛，我唔會推薦。

reviews.text: literally so pretty!!! If you have longer lashes I recommend 11 mm. I used 11 mm in the middle of my lashes and mixed some 9 mm into it.I also didn’t place it beneath my lashes I just put it a bit higher because I was scared but it still looks natural.
reviews.zh: 真係好靚！！！如果你嘅睫毛比較長，我推薦 11mm。我喺自己睫毛中間用咗 11mm，再混入啲 9mm。我亦唔係貼喺真睫毛底下，而係放高少少，因為我好驚，不過睇落仍然好自然。

reviews.text: I love this lashes and it's coming from someone who thinks every type of false lash looks unnatural and heavy. It does take a bit more time to apply than strip lashes but once you get the hang of it, it's a no brainer. It adds just the right amount of oomph -- I love it!
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款睫毛，而且係由一個覺得所有假睫毛都好假同厚重嘅人講嘅。佢裝嘅時間比整條睫毛多少少，但係掌握咗之後，就易如反掌。佢啱啱好增添咗一點神采——我好鍾意！
